Agent
The upper management want to ask our property managers their honest thoughts on our boss’s software, PropertyMax - we know they dislike a lot of it and are annoyed by redundancies but they are timid to share. Give me some ways I can do a survey where they will comfortable sharing but do it anonymously 
Yesterday, 11:36 PM
Here are the best ways to run an anonymous survey that'll actually get honest feedback:
FREE & EASY OPTIONS:
Google Forms (Anonymous Mode) — Best bet
Create the survey in Google Forms
Go to Settings → turn OFF "Collect email addresses"
Turn OFF "Limit to 1 response" (so it doesn't track accounts)
Share via a generic link — they click it, fill it out, no names attached
You get the results in a spreadsheet with zero identifying info
They trust Google Forms because everyone knows it's anonymous when email collection is off
Microsoft Forms (since you're on Exchange)
Same concept — create the form, disable "Record name"
Share via link
Results come back anonymous
Might feel more "corporate approved" since it's Microsoft
SurveyMonkey (Free tier — 10 questions, 25 responses)
surveymonkey.com
Built-in anonymous mode
Looks more professional/third-party which builds trust
TIPS TO GET HONEST ANSWERS:
Don't send the link from Marc's email or your company email — use a neutral source
Put a note at the top: "This survey is 100% anonymous. No names, emails, or IP addresses are collected. Your responses cannot be traced back to you."
Use a mix of rating scales (1-5) AND open text boxes — people are more honest typing freely than picking from options
Don't make it too long — 8-10 questions max
Include questions like "What would you eliminate if you could?" and "What takes the most time for the least value?"
Share results back with the team afterward (builds trust for future surveys)
SUGGESTED QUESTIONS:
On a scale of 1-5, how useful is PropertyMax.ai in your daily work?
What features do you use the most?
What features do you never use?
What's the most frustrating part of PropertyMax.ai?
Do you feel PropertyMax.ai has reduced or increased your workload? (Reduced / No change / Increased)
Are there tasks you're doing in PropertyMax that you're also doing somewhere else? (Yes/No + explain)
If you could change one thing about PropertyMax.ai, what would it be?
What tools/systems would you eliminate if you could?
How much time per day do you spend on PropertyMax.ai? (Less than 30 min / 30-60 min / 1-2 hrs / 2+ hrs)
Any additional comments?
Want me to build the actual Google Form or create an HTML survey you can host yourself?
Give this to me in a pdf
One sec.
